
---

## Downloads

| Platform | File |
|---|---|
| Windows (installer) | `Dotstell_*_x64_en-US.msi` |
| Windows (setup) | `Dotstell_*_x64-setup.exe` |
| macOS Apple Silicon | `Dotstell_*_aarch64.dmg` |
| macOS Intel | `Dotstell_*_x64.dmg` |
| Linux | `dotstell_*_amd64.AppImage` / `.deb` |

> **Note:** Builds are currently unsigned.
> - **macOS:** right-click the `.dmg` and choose **Open** to bypass Gatekeeper
> - **Windows:** click **More info → Run anyway** on the SmartScreen prompt
> - **Linux:** run `chmod +x *.AppImage` before launching
